Name: Bleed
Overview:
Wryn is a girl with purple hair and a big dream: she wants to be the ultimate videogame heroine. She also happens to have a large arsenal of weapons, so she starts a journey to take down the Greatest Heroes of All Time and claim the title for herself.

Bleed is a fast 2D side-scrolling action game with traditional gameplay elements such as running, jumping, shooting and avoiding enemies and other obstacles. The game consists of seven levels and has four difficulty settings. Besides the "normal" game mode there is also an arcade mode (just one life), a challenge mode (battle three bosses at once), and a local two-player co-op mode. There are also three unlockable characters.
